home.tagline: Science meets Sanskar: a bridge to a brighter future
home.definitionBody: The sanskar done upon the garbha is called garbha sanskar.
home.quoteMeaning: Sanskar means the sacred act of transforming something, or a being, of lesser quality into superior qualities.
home.agniveshAddress: F6, 1st floor, Time Square Complex, Deesa–Palanpur Highway, near One Center Mall, Sardar Patel Nagar, Palanpur, Gujarat 385001
home.sanidhiAddress: First floor, SF Sai Complex, Gobri Road, Palanpur, Gujarat 385001
home.mapPreview: If the map does not load, use the Google Maps link below.
home.heroEyebrow: Pregnancy wellbeing, with culture and clinical context
home.heroBody: GarbhaSetu brings traditional Garbha Sanskar guidance and pregnancy physiotherapy into one calm, supportive care experience in Palanpur.
home.traditionBody: Garbha Sanskar is presented here as a cultural approach to thoughtful routines, reflection, family participation, and care during pregnancy. It can sit alongside regular antenatal healthcare, but it does not replace medical advice or predict a child’s qualities or birth outcome.
home.boundaryBody: Choose only activities that feel appropriate for you. Exercise, treatment, nutrition, and clinical timing need individual assessment from a qualified professional.
home.practicesTitle: Small ways to create a supportive routine
home.practicesIntro: The supplied GarbhaSetu material includes reading, music, conversation, creative reflection, and journaling. These are optional wellbeing activities, not prescriptions or promises.

practices.title: Reading and music
practices.body: Choose calm reading, prayer, singing, or music as personal reflection and relaxation activities.
practices.imageAlt: An open book beside a warm drink in soft natural light

practices.title: Garbha Samvad
practices.body: Parents may use warm conversation to express feelings and build a personal sense of connection during pregnancy.
practices.imageAlt: Two people sharing a quiet conversation at home

practices.title: Creative reflection
practices.body: Drawing, painting, puzzles, or clay can be optional ways to pause, focus, and enjoy time together.
practices.imageAlt: A journal and art materials arranged on a table

practices.title: A wellness journal
practices.body: Simple notes about routines, questions, and follow-up dates can help prepare for discussions with the care team.
practices.imageAlt: A notebook open for reflective writing

home.familyTitle: Practical support from family and chosen companions
home.familyBody: Support can mean listening, sharing daily work, attending education, preparing for birth, or helping after delivery. Every family and pregnancy is different, so participation should follow the parent’s preferences.
home.stagesIntro: These links describe GarbhaSetu services. They are not a universal pregnancy timeline.

stages.title: Antenatal support
stages.body: Education, movement, posture, rest, and individual wellbeing guidance.

stages.title: Labour preparation
stages.body: Breathing, positioning, partner education, and documented support options.

stages.title: Lactation support
stages.body: Positioning, latch education, posture, and comfort guidance after birth.

stages.title: Postpartum rehabilitation
stages.body: Assessment-led support for gradual function, core, and pelvic-floor recovery.

services.title: Ayurveda and physiotherapy
services.intro: Garbha sanskar guidance with Dr. Jagrut Chauhan, and pregnancy physiotherapy with Dr. Richa Madhu.
services.ayurvedaIntro: Counselling, diet and daily routine, and psychological and spiritual guidance.
services.counselBody: Personal sessions for the parents’ questions, preparation of mindset, and emotional wellbeing through pregnancy.
services.dietBody: Ahara and vihara according to Ayurveda, including ritucharya and the garbhini routine, set out by trimester from classical Ayurvedic texts.
mindItems: Month-by-month reading selected for reflection, values, and emotional wellbeing
Swadhyay and prayer, including local prayers
Meditation, Om and mantra chanting, and the mother’s humming and singing
Yoga and pranayama suitable for pregnancy, and stress management
Garbha sangeet and music for wellness and relaxation, for example Jijabai na halarda and Krishna-theme music
Motivational and spiritual writing, listening, and reading
Positive reflection about pregnancy and parenthood
services.samvadBody: During pregnancy, the parents connect with the unborn child through love, feeling, and positive emotion. They talk with the child, speak loving words, express their feelings, and share positive experiences together.
services.activitiesIntro: A personal daily activity is sent on WhatsApp and checked each day.
activities: Drawing and painting, including mandala art, as an optional creative activity for the mother
services.journalBody: A journal is given for daily food, hours of sleep, medicine, water intake, an exercise chart, a checkbox for the daily task, the follow-up date, and session notes. It also includes education about body weight, with a positive approach.
services.physioTitle: Clinical care by Dr. Richa Madhu (PT)
services.physioIntro: Antenatal care, preparation for labour, lactation support, and postpartum assessment and management.

pillars.title: Lactation support
pillars.body: Latching, and care for neck and thoracic discomfort.

pillars.title: Postpartum care
pillars.body: Assessment, and recovery of the core and pelvic floor.

ancItems: Awareness of psychological changes during pregnancy, and an explanation of physiological changes
Lifestyle changes, including nutrition guidelines, and sleep and rest
Sleep position, sitting position, and changes for daily work
Breathing exercises for relaxation, and for intercostal pain and discomfort
services.safetyBody: Physiotherapy electrical modalities are not given in the childbearing period. TENS and therapeutic ultrasound are not used during antenatal care.
services.exerciseIntro: These are taught according to the stage of pregnancy and the mother’s own needs.
exerciseItems: Upper- and lower-limb strengthening, with or without resistance, in a low-risk mother
familyItems: Education and awareness for the father and the family
Partner involvement, supportive communication, and massage techniques for labour
Warning signs and red flags that need immediate contact with the consultant
redFlags: Severe abdominal pain or sudden swelling
labourItems: A partner or relative for emotional support and tactile stimulation
Positions in labour on a physio ball
TENS and massage for pain relief in labour
A cooling pad for pain after a vaginal delivery
Breathing, relaxation, and labour positions taught beforehand
services.labourPlansTitle: Two ways labour support is offered
services.lactationIntro: Guidance so that breastfeeding after birth can be simpler and more comfortable for mother and baby.
lactationItems: Advice for nipple pain and irritation during breastfeeding
Advice for flat or inverted nipples
Advice on a nipple shield for flat, inverted, or cracked nipples
Advice about massage on the breasts
Teaching the mother about a pump, if needed
services.postIntro: A personal programme to bring the body gradually back toward its previous function. The timing is decided after assessment. It is not the same for every mother.
postItems: Education about the pelvic floor muscles, with the help of a model
Functional activity progression: lifting the baby, sitting, standing, and daily activities
Caesarean incision positioning advice and scar mobilisation
Scar mobilisation, at the right time, for an earlier surgery or another scar
services.timingBody: The start of exercise after birth is not the same for every mother. Whether the birth was a normal delivery or a caesarean section, what happened during the birth, and the medical condition should be assessed by the physiotherapist before the time is decided. A fixed rule of 6 weeks or 10 weeks should not be applied to everyone.
services.emotionBody: The father and the family have an important place in garbha sanskar. Counselling covers emotional support for the mother, help with daily tasks, preparation for birth, and taking part in the baby’s care. It also covers emotional changes after birth, including possible signs of postpartum depression, and encourages seeing a mental-health specialist when needed.
modalities: TENS and therapeutic ultrasound for pain management after delivery
Electrical stimulation for pelvic-floor training in incontinence, prolapse, and vaginal laxity after birth
tools: Vonfidans, for pelvic-floor assessment and rehabilitation
500 g to 1 kg dumbbells and resistance bands for strengthening in antenatal and postnatal care
rooms: Air conditioning, and a speaker for garbha sangeet
Yellow light for meditation and dhyan
Postpartum weight-reduction equipment only at Sanidhi Physiotherapy Clinic
services.journeyTitle: Clear sections for each stage of care
services.journeyBody: Choose a section to understand what the supplied GarbhaSetu material says. Individual assessment determines which clinical guidance applies.
